description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of planning permission reference: P/2026/01302/HH dated 10th August 2026 for the "Erection of a rear dormer roof extension, following the demolition of existing; erection of a two storey rear extension to the side of the back addition at second and first floor level, over part of the ground floor rear extension; erection of a single storey side infill extension; installation of a new window to replace existing, to the rear elevation at first floor level; alterations to the existing ground floor rear extension including installation of associated rooflights and new doors to the rear elevation; Installation of a new side access door fronting Doneraile Street within the proposed side extension, following the removal of the existing garden gate. excavation of the front garden and under the footprint of the building to form front lightwells, in connection with the enlargement of the existing basement; replacement of existing first and second floor windows on the rear and side of the back addition with double glazed windows." Amendments sought to substitute previously approved proposed side elevation (drawing no. 1692 / 000-2) and proposed sections BB and CC (drawing no. 1692 / 000-2) with the amended drawings to include the inclusion of a rooflight, alignment of the rear dormer, and correction of the dashed lines indicating the ground floor structure behind the Doneraile Street wall.
